title: Beyond Leaderboards: A Method for Application-Specific Capability Profiling of Large Language Models
title_zh: 【超越排行榜：一种面向特定应用的大语言模型能力画像方法】

paragraphs.en: 本文提出一种针对具体应用场景的大语言模型能力画像方法，以容器化测试床实现，强调测量结果仅适用于特定应用而非通用排名。 Public leaderboards rank large language models (LLMs) in general, but an engineer has to choose a model for a specific application, architecture and cost. This paper presents a method for application-specific capability profiling of LLMs and its realization as a containerized testbed. The method treats each application as a unit of extension: an Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration agent, a documentation-grounded chatbot or an enterprise-support automation agent runs in its own container behind a small contract, brings its own dataset, evaluator and owned attributes, and is onboarded together with its dashboards. Measurements accumulate in a versioned, sparse metamodel of every model. The method separates the model under test from judges and agents, freezes and hashes plans, refuses to compare values from different contexts, diagnoses the instrument before the system, and applies a null-agent check and a noise rule whose operating characteristics are quantified by simulation. In the evaluated automation conditions, model choices produced larger differences on selected observable outcomes than framework choices, although the experimental design does not establish a general causal ranking of these factors. The experiments also show that instruction tuning is deployment-specific and that system-reported success can exceed independently observed success: of 216 migration units checked against a real Oracle database, 108 were demonstrably correct. These measurements establish application-specific observations, not a universal model ranking.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出一种面向具体应用场景的大语言模型能力画像方法，并将其实现为容器化测试床。公共排行榜对大语言模型（LLM）进行通用排名，但工程师必须为特定的应用、架构和成本选择模型。 本文提出一种针对具体应用场景的大语言模型能力画像方法，并将其实现为容器化测试床。 该方法将每个应用视为扩展单元：Oracle 到 PostgreSQL 迁移智能体、基于文档的聊天机器人或企业支持自动化智能体，各自在小型契约背后的独立容器中运行，自带数据集、评估器和自有属性，并与其仪表板一同接入。 测量结果累积在每个模型带版本的稀疏元模型中。 该方法将被测模型与裁判和智能体分离，冻结计划并计算哈希，拒绝比较来自不同上下文的数值，在诊断系统之前先诊断测量工具，并应用空智能体检查和噪声规则，其运行特性通过仿真进行量化。 在所评估的自动化条件下，模型选择在某些可观测结果上产生的差异大于框架选择，尽管实验设计并未建立这些因素的一般因果排序。 实验还表明，指令微调是部署特定的，且系统报告的成功率可能高于独立观测的成功率：在与真实 Oracle 数据库核对的 216 个迁移单元中，108 个被证明是正确的。 这些测量建立的是针对具体应用的观察结果，而非通用的模型排名。
